chapter: Joseph Thomas band and house parties
title: Rehearsing with a white family band
summary: Williams recalls rehearsing with a white neighbour, guitarist Paul Lane, whose sister played bass and who played Dixieland, and a pianist named Oscar Pierce.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I used to rehearse with a white fella, Paul Lane. Paul Lane? Yeah.
He was a guitar player and he had a family band, white.
And you used to go on rehearsals?

I used to rehearse with the next door neighbor. His sister played bass, played one of them bass. He played Dixieland music, you know. And the other fella they called Oscar, Oscar Pierce, he played piano.
It's all new names to me.
Yeah, the fella from way, way back.
